# Impeccable Uplift Review

Review goal: scan every upstream `pbakaus/impeccable` skill and absorb only the mechanics that make the existing local skill graph sharper.

## Outcome Summary
- Status: selective uplift complete
- New live skill surfaces added: `0`
- Existing local skills strengthened: `6`
- Upstream tree remains quarantined for reference only

## Live Uplifts
- `frontend-design`: design-context handshake before routing
- `frontend-ui-design`: design-context minimum, anti-generic first-viewport checks, UX copy guidance, and intensity tuning
- `ui-ux-creative-coding`: high-ambition mode with direction approval, fallback rules, and browser verification
- `product-design-critic`: cognitive-load lens, persona stress test, and red-flag output section
- `baseline-ui`: flow-friction overlay for audit mode
- `design-system`: normalization-first and extraction-threshold rules plus migration-path expectations

## Recommendation
- Keep the remaining upstream skills quarantined.
- Continue promoting only mechanics, references, and review heuristics into existing local owners.
- Revisit `bolder` or `onboard` later only if user demand becomes repeated enough to justify a dedicated canonical lane.
